products.name: H6 Hollow Block
products.tagline: Hollow on one side. Closed on the other.
products.description: The H6 hollow concrete block from Snow Holdings: 400 × 150 × 200 mm, hollow on one side and closed on the other, for walling on homes, commercial and farm buildings in Uganda.

highlights.text: A six-inch block for walling on homes, commercial and farm buildings.

highlights.title: Closed on one side
highlights.text: One solid face gives a full, even surface to build on.

highlights.title: Hollow on the other
highlights.text: Open cores keep the block lighter to carry and lay.

highlights.title: Made by Snow Holdings
highlights.text: Cast in our own production, so quality is controlled from the start.

story.title: Closed on one side.

products.name: Interlocking Paver
products.description: The Interlocking Paver (P20) from Snow Holdings: 200 × 160 × 60 mm, in our standard design or made to yours, for driveways, compounds and walkways in Uganda.

highlights.title: {{size}} mm
highlights.text: A 60 mm paver for driveways, compounds and walkways.

highlights.title: Locks into its neighbours
highlights.text: Each paver's shape keys into the ones around it, so the surface works as one.

highlights.title: Standard or custom
highlights.text: P20 in our standard design, or CP20 made in the size you ask for.

highlights.title: Made by Snow Holdings
highlights.text: Cast in our own production, so quality is controlled from the start.

story.title: One paver.
story.text: A wide end, a narrow waist and a wide end again: the shape does the work.

story.title: Shaped to interlock.
story.text: Each wide end slides into the waist of the pavers beside it.

story.title: Laid as one surface.
story.text: Row after row, the pavers hold each other in place across the whole area.
